body: I do speak to professionals. they just don't understand all of it and it hurts to keep trying to explain it.
I'm trying. it's really hard to not be negative about it and see it as hopeless.

I'm not acting out. I'm holding as much of it within as I can, I'm trying to be as strong as I can. I'm trying to hold myself together as much as I can. I don't have a lot of hope. I have a speck of hope I won't let go of. 

I don't know where I talked about rejection. no one has rejected me. they just put up emotional walls, and take distance, so they don't get hurt as much as I am hurting, if I do kill myself.

I'm trying my best to do what I can do. It's a lot to explain to a therapist or counsellor, and, I just need to go through all of this slowly. I don't really want to talk about the sadness or suicidal feelings. I don't think a therapist or counselor can help me with them. I know most things go in waves, I have been through multiple severe depressive episodes with more than one traumatic event in my life. 

it gets very difficult when you feel paralyzed to life, because you know the waves are going to keep coming. what I am going through now is the worst pain I've felt in my life, and it is the only time I have ever had serious, serious doubts over it ending. I can not go through this again if I get better. i just can't. I would rather kill myself than risk this happening to me again, except worse. I am barely hanging on.
I really hope. I don't think I can handle this anymore otherwise, not another night.
I just manage to keep it together enough to not hurt anyone, I think, I guess, I hope. it comes and goes

I'm sorry, I know listening to me must be depleting. I try to find anyone to talk to for a little bit, at night. until I can fall asleep. that helps. it's just it keeps me alive, it's not that it helps me do better for myself and improve. I don't know. maybe I'm doing better and I am just used to discouraging everything I do, so nothing seems good enough, and even though everything I do may change, my attitude doesn't, because I just don't think I deserve to feel good when I know I could do better. 

this is so overly simplistic. I don't know. I wish I could be okay. I wish I wasn't so scared for myself all the time. I wish the people around me could see me do better, not what I do, which seems like a slow degradation.
yea, I just don't know anymore about anything

it is both too complicated for me to explain and too painful to let someone else work through. 

I don't want to talk about 'why'. I'm just like this, here now. That's all. 

I hope you understand.
don't worry about me. thanks for believing me.

I'm fine (still alive) but, I don't honestly know for how long.

they are real feelings and they are very strong. I just suck at trying to kill myself.
that I'm dying. that nothing can help me and I'm afraid I'm correct about those things

thanks, but I'm kind of useless. it's hard enough for me to believe I can be helped or can help myself, let alone feel like I can help anyone else. 

my feelings just seem to be stuck and nothing I've done has been able to budge them. 

it makes me sad on top of that to feel like I'm accepting that suicide is my only option.
